# Load the data

# Check if any QA orders are in the target group
qa_in_target_group = qa_orders[(qa_orders['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (qa_orders['channel'] == 'paid_search')]
print(f"QA orders in 'new' + 'paid_search' group after parsing: {len(qa_in_target_group)}")"}
